title: "Calculus Notes"

These notes migrate the original Julia Pluto calculus notebooks to executable Python marimo notebooks. The Julia sources are preserved in the repository's `julia-pluto` history.

## Migrated chapters

### [Chapter 10: Taylor and Fourier series](ch10.qmd)

Taylor polynomials, convergence of power series, and Fourier approximation of a square wave.

### [Chapter 11: Differential equations](ch11.qmd)

Direction fields, Euler's method, growth and decay, applied models, SIR and Lotka-Volterra systems, harmonic motion, and damping.

## Scope

Chapters 10 and 11 contain the available source material for phase 6. Chapters 12 through 15 currently contain no source notebooks.

The interactive notebook pages below are exported directly from marimo and can also be downloaded as Python source files.
